title: Reject the False Pass: turn judged failures into semantic gates

local: npx playwright test tests/release-v01643.spec.js tests/export-smoke.spec.js --grep "downloads representative|v0.16.43"

ciFast.note: Fast verification will confirm the same semantic replay, full test suite, build, and bundle gates after the release branch is pushed.

ciDeep.note: This bounded compiler-quality milestone does not claim a trained adapter, held-out full-course win, paid-reference parity, or new device result.

deploy.note: The release will deploy from the merged main commit after required verification succeeds.

liveProvider.note: The semantic replay uses retained source-grounded artifacts and the browser/compiler code path; it makes no fresh provider or model call.

manualHuman.note: No human or instructor judgment is claimed or required.

strictLayeredEvaluation.note: The main layered evaluation passes the 40-fixture compiler contract, 13-case evidence-aware benchmark, and retained production canaries. The current release claim remains limited to conservative interception of nine previously judged Scion losses with zero model-text mutation; independent instructor evidence is still unverified, and this does not prove that the remaining outputs are factually correct or that an adapter beats base Scion.

claims.summary: All 46 stable paired-order Scion losses replay through both the frozen v0.16.42 compiler and the current compiler; interception rises from zero to nine.
Three stable wrong keys are realigned from unique exact affirmative explanation cues; only one answer-index field changes per artifact and no model-authored text changes.
Shared admission rejects two cosmetically duplicated option sets and four answer-only explanations into targeted regeneration.
The stricter retained-source replay admits 141/192 atoms instead of the prior 149/192, raising burden from 43 to 51 while preserving all retained model-response text.
Thirty-seven stable losses remain unresolved; the corpus stays at 46/100 model-judge preferences and no quality adapter is trained, active, or promoted.
